title: Baked Feta Soup
subtitle: with Pumpkin and Crunchy Croutons
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced. Peel the pumpkin and cut into 2cm chunks. Finely chop the chives. Crush or finely chop the garlic. Chop 20g butter into small chunks.

Bake soup ingredients: Put the pumpkin, garlic, tomatoes, half the feta, half the butter and 1 tsp sugar in a small baking dish, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Bake on the upper oven shelf for 35 mins or until the pumpkin is tender.

Make croutons: Meanwhile, line an oven tray with baking paper. Tear the bread into small pieces. Put the remaining butter on the lined tray and cook on the lower shelf for 1 min or until the butter is mostly melted. Put the bread pieces on the melted butter, scatter with the Tuscan seasoning and toss to coat. Return to the oven and cook, tossing halfway, for 8 mins or until golden.

Blend soup: Add 250ml (1 cup) boiling water to the pumpkin mixture. Blend the pumpkin mixture in the dish with a stick blender until smooth (see Kitchen hack). Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Return to the oven and cook for a further 2 mins or until warmed through.
Serve up: Divide the soup among bowls and top with the croutons. Crumble over the remaining feta and sprinkle with the chives. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, if using, and enjoy!

Kitchen hack: If you prefer, transfer the pumpkin mixture to a deep bowl, blend until smooth, then return to the dish to heat through. Or simply mash the pumpkin mixture with a potato masher. The result won't be as smooth but it will be just as delicious!
